triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:server` · `pm:blocked` (behind #35489 / PR #35805); rationale: area:data · Bug · Broken once PR #35805 lands (an organization that ever created a unit can no longer be deleted: the delete is restricted by its units, and units refuse every delete) · admins offboarding tenants, rare but with no remedy → p2 · size S. The maintainer ruled the fix, option B, verbatim: 「删组织时一并删单位」. Land it with or right after PR #35805, so no window ships where an organization cannot be deleted.

repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvvVzM5KhCWkT5f45c

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-20T18:06Z · release pairing for this card

#35805 is on main and refuses every `sys_unit` delete. Until this card lands, an organization that holds a unit cannot be deleted. The seat asked whether the held release waits for this card. At 2026-11-20T18:06Z Tesla chose 「继续暂缓,先做 #35812」: the Version Packages release stays held until this card merges, and the card is dispatched now. That is an explicit exception to his p1-only dispatch word (2026-11-20T17:07Z); the grade stays p2. Seat 7 hands it to area d7-D (units).

Claim: PM loop round 3 · card thread d7-D · 2026-11-20T18:08Z
Ordered by: seat 7, 2026-11-20T18:07Z: take this card now; the maintainer chose at 2026-11-20T18:06Z to keep the Version Packages release held until it merges (7046995545), an explicit exception to his p1-only word, grade stays p2
Area: d7-D
Session: `session_01L9qibvMi1U7R2kBd3JbTPu`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/project-thread-dr6px1` (the one branch this thread can push). It now carries the ADR-0158 amendment PR #35903, which is waiting for its Tier H approval, so this card is built in its own worktree now and pushed once #35903 has merged and the branch is restarted from main. If #35903 is still waiting when the build is done, the seat is asked for another pushing thread.
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-35812`
Domain: `domain:server`
Seat: `repo:objectstack#7`
File surface: `packages/objectql/src/` — `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` (the `refuseOrganizationUnitDelete` call), `validation/unit-code-membership.ts` (the refusal), `engine-cascade-planning.ts` and `engine-delete-cascade.ts` (the organization delete's cascade, `refuseOrganizationDeleteWhileOwned`, `organizationOwnedRowCounts`), `engine.ts` where these are bound, their tests, a real-stack integration pin where an organization delete runs (its package's test dir), and root `.changeset/`. ⛔ No `docs/adr/**` (the ADR-0158 Open item 11 sentence is amended by a later PR), no `ui/**`. Stop on breach and report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — no path-derived mandate (dispatch-gates --tier); contract (L2) review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, because this widens a refusal on a delete door`, `effort: high` (seat 7's word, 2026-11-20T18:07Z)
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `introduced-by #35805 (the unconditional sys_unit delete refusal); the maintainer ruled option B before it merged and option C shipped in the meantime`
Thread-read: 7046995545
Premise: holds — on main at `f44758b21e`, `refuseOrganizationUnitDelete(object)` is unconditional and runs first in the engine's `delete()` (`engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts:176`), and the organization delete's pre-check counts `sys_unit` rows as blocking ownership, so an organization that holds a unit is refused `DELETE_RESTRICTED` with no remedy.
Serial constraints cleared: `Blocked-by: #35489` — the code this card waits on is PR #35805, merged as `e1143241de`. #35489 stays open only for the ADR-0158 amendment PR #35903, which this card's code does not need.
Scope-review: exempt — the route is ruled: option B, 「删组织时一并删单位」 (7035627429). The exemption is carried by the engine's own cascade claim, never by a caller flag or a context bit, so a direct unit delete stays refused in every context.
Pre-claim lane: `area:data` seat 7 (#35557)
Pre-claim deps: #35805 merged
Prior rulings read: ADR-0158 Open item 11 note (2026-11-19, a deleted code stays retired) and its amendment on PR #35903; ruling B 7035627429; release hold 7046995545
